why: The two hatched squares jump between the diagonals: top-left + bottom-right, then top-right + bottom-left, again and again. The book picks option 1, which keeps the hatched top-right square with the same slanting lines as figure 4. Option 2 and option 4 use straight (vertical or horizontal) lines, so they do not fit.
trick: In shading series, first check the direction of the shading lines; an option with a new kind of line is usually wrong.
note: By the swapping rule the 5th figure should show top-left and bottom-right hatched again; no option shows that. Book answer A (option 1) is kept, but the question looks faulty.
